content.title: Horoscope for Wednesday, 4/1/26 by Georgia Nicols
content.text: Today is April Fools' Day. It is also the Full Moon in LIBRA, which highlights matters of balance, relationships and fairness.jimkruger/Getty ImagesToday is April Fools' Day. It is also the Full Moon in LIBRA, which highlights matters of balance, relationships and fairness.In the morning, the Moon is trine Pluto, adding depth and intensity to emotions and conversations. Soon afterward, it opposes stern Saturn, triggering a sudden reality check. ("License and registration, please.") Tread carefully.Article continues below this adGet Digital Access and Stay Informed With Trusted Local News.Get Digital Access and Stay Informed With Trusted Local News.ONLY 25¢What begins as lighthearted or playful could shift into something more serious if boundaries are crossed. Be mindful of timing and tone, especially in close relationships. Weigh your words and consider long-term consequences. Thomas Jefferson said, "Honesty is the first chapter in the book of wisdom." Groucho Marx said, "The secret of life is honesty -- and if you can fake that, you've got it made."Moon Alert:There are no restrictions to shopping or important decisions today. The Full Moon in LIBRA peaks at 10:12 p.m. EDT (7:12 p.m. PDT).Make CT Insider a preferred source on Google to see more of our journalism when you search.Add Preferred SourceThe Stars Show the Kind of Day You'll Have:5-Dynamic; 4-Positive; 3-Average; 2-So-so; 1-DifficultArticle continues below this adAries (March 21-April 19) ★★ Today the Full Moon is opposite your sign, which could create concerns about long-term committed relationships. You might question how you function in them. You might question how you got involved. How would you finish the sentence "What people want out of me is ..."? Tonight: Genuinely listen.Taurus (April 20-May 20) ★★★ Today you're concerned with your work and your health because of the energy of the Full Moon. It's important for you to feel useful and productive. Do you think your job is something where you should get by with as little as possible? Or do you think you're always working for yourself and your own self-respect? Tonight: Get organized.Gemini (May 21-June 20) ★★★ Today's Full Moon might create problems when dealing with your kids or a romantic relationship, or it might even make you doubt your creative talents. Why not pursue activities that give you joy? Life is full of a series of little pleasures. It doesn't have to be all or nothing. Tonight: Enjoy playful diversions.Cancer (June 21-July 22) ★★ You are a moon child, and today's Full Moon might make you feel caught between the demands of home and family versus the demands of your career or your external world. You can't please both. For this particular Full Moon, you can't ignore your career or authority figures. Tonight: Relax.Article continues below this adLeo (July 23-Aug. 22) ★★★ Pay attention to everything you say and do today because this is a mildly accident-prone day due to the Full Moon energy. Communication is important to you today. You might feel you have to say something or share an idea with someone. Or perhaps no one will listen. Go gently. Tonight: A meaningful conversation.Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22) ★★★ The Full Moon today takes place in your Money House, which might trigger disputes with others about money, earnings or something that you own. You might even argue about your values, especially as they relate to shared property and shared responsibilities. Stay calm. Tonight: Check your money.Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22) ★★ You like harmony in your surroundings. Although you're an excellent debater, you don't like confrontations. Today is the only Full Moon in your sign all year, which can create difficulty with partners and close friends. Be aware of this and tread carefully. Tonight: You're strong.Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21) ★★★ Today's Full Moon energy might create disputes with co-workers, health care workers or a pet. Basically, every Full Moon is in opposition of the Sun and the Moon, which means these two energies are "fighting." It lasts about 48 hours. Tonight: Privacy.Article continues below this adSagittarius (Nov. 22-Dec. 21) ★★★ You might encounter some difficulty when dealing with friends and groups today, especially if they are related to your kids, a vacation, a social situation or anything to do with sports and education. It's hard to reconcile opposing ideas. Relax. You don't have to be right. Just be a caring person. Tonight: Be friendly.Capricorn (Dec. 22-Jan. 19) ★★ Today a public argument might take place in which you're involved. It could be noticeable, or it might be a whispered argument in an elevator. Whatever the case, today's Full Moon might aggravate your dealings with bosses, parents and authority figures. Stay chill. Tonight: Show respect.Aquarius (Jan. 20-Feb. 18) ★★★ Steer clear of controversial subjects today because the Full Moon will only exacerbate things. People feel heated emotions today that override their logic. Therefore, your best bet is to walk on by. Don't make waves. Tonight: Explore and learn.Pisces (Feb. 19-March 20) ★★★ Disputes or differences of opinions about shared property, taxes, debt, insurance issues as well as shared responsibilities are likely today because of the Full Moon. Don't get caught up in this! Keep your head down and your powder dry. Tonight: Check your finances.Article continues below this adIf Your Birthday Is April 1:You are dignified, wise and quietly confident. You're also positive, organized and energetic. This year is about service, perhaps to family. Because you might be a support for those who turn to you for guidance, comfort and courage, it's important to take care of yourself.
